title: Russian Roulette
summary: Will Western owners re-enter the Russian oil trades? The Russian oil trade after the attack on Ukraine and its impact on the tanker market is difficult to analyze because there are so many moving parts (some of which are hidden as well ...). On the one hand, there are major disruptions in trade flows, which have been, in general, positive for the freight market.
